info.title: three.ws Agent Trust
info.description: Counterparty checks for AI agents: 0-100 reputation scores for wallets, mints, and agents from on-chain evidence, admit or refuse verdicts against a trust policy, on-chain identity claim verification, and sourced fact checks.
info.x-guidance: Call an endpoint without payment to receive an x402 challenge, pay it in USDC on Solana mainnet, and retry with the payment header. Asynchronous 3D jobs return a token to poll for free at GET /api/forge?job=<token>.

get.summary: Score a wallet, token, or AI agent for trust from 0 to 100
get.description: Return a deterministic 0-100 trust score for a wallet, token mint, ERC-8004 agent id, or three.ws agent id from transaction history, age, counterparties, holdings, and settled agent payments.

parameters.name: subject
parameters.description: Counterparty to score: a Solana or EVM wallet, a token mint, an ERC-8004 agent id, or a three.ws agent id.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Optional EVM chain id or CAIP-2 chain to resolve an EVM subject on.

400.description: Missing or invalid input. Refused before any payment settles.

402.description: Payment Required: an x402 challenge payable in USDC on Solana mainnet.

get.summary: Check whether to admit an AI agent by its payment record
get.description: Read a three.ws agent's Solana track record (payments, distinct payers, failure rate, attestations) and return an admit or refuse verdict with a tier: newcomer, regular, trusted, or vip.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: three.ws agent id (UUID) of the counterparty to check.

parameters.name: min_payments
parameters.description: Minimum confirmed on-chain payments the agent must have received.

parameters.name: min_distinct_payers
parameters.description: Minimum number of distinct wallets that have paid the agent.

parameters.name: max_failure_rate
parameters.description: Highest acceptable payment failure rate, from 0 to 1.

parameters.name: min_attestations
parameters.description: Minimum signed Solana attestations the agent must hold.

parameters.name: allow_newcomers
parameters.description: Admit agents with no history yet instead of refusing them.

400.description: Missing or invalid input. Refused before any payment settles.

402.description: Payment Required: an x402 challenge payable in USDC on Solana mainnet.

get.summary: Verify that an identity controls a wallet, mint, or contract
get.description: Check a claim that an identity controls an address and return on-chain evidence (deployer, mint and update authority, name resolution, agent registration) with verified true, false, or unverifiable.

parameters.name: identity
parameters.description: Claimed identity: a wallet, a name-service name, an ERC-8004 agent id, or a three.ws agent id.

parameters.name: address
parameters.description: Contract, mint, or wallet the identity claims to control.

parameters.name: chain
parameters.description: Optional CAIP-2 chain hint for the address.

400.description: Missing or invalid input. Refused before any payment settles.

402.description: Payment Required: an x402 challenge payable in USDC on Solana mainnet.

post.summary: Verify a factual claim and return a sourced verdict
post.description: Check a claim against live web sources and return supported, contradicted, mixed, or insufficient with cited sources, a confidence score, and a SHA-256 attestation. The first 3 checks per day per IP are free.

claim.description: One factual statement to check, 5 to 1,000 characters.

strictness.description: How hard low-authority sources are downweighted: high, medium, or low.

imageUrl.description: Optional public image URL to check alongside the claim.

example.claim: The Eiffel Tower is 330 meters tall.
